title: Bound owed verification binds before a batch gate fans out, instead of leaving them unbounded
outcome: A session's owed verification binds have a precise durable capacity, enforced BEFORE a batch gate creates new dispatched uncertainty: the gate's whole member fan-out is reserved up front, or unsent target binds are declined with their status reported. A potentially dispatched bind is never dropped or turned into refused/bound by the cap, and existing over-cap state stays readable.
acceptance: Bound owed verification binds before a batch gate fans out, instead of leaving them unbounded is done
